description: Fallback-state companion to the103-page route inventory. In progress is not release acceptance. Review these states with their parent routes and source-bound browser/device evidence.

src/app/not-found.tsx.note: Standalone product-aware missing-route view; actual status/noindex/locale and product home evidence required.

src/app/error.tsx.note: Standalone route/layout-child error surface; explicit read refresh/reset, no private error text.

src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx.note: Missing-route view inside existing localized shell; preserve404 and existing authorization/redirect contracts.

src/app/[locale]/error.tsx.note: Localized recoverable route error; manual retry revalidates reads without replaying form actions.

src/app/[locale]/admin/loading.tsx.note: Existing administrator loading boundary, reused embedded indeterminate view; no new public streaming boundary.

src/app/global-error.tsx.note: Root-layout failure bypasses product context: neutral bilingual AkiSuite document, explicit manual GET retry, no error details.

deliberatelyNotInstalled.src/app/[locale]/loading.tsx: Actual Next framework testing changed404 to200 when this global loading boundary streamed. Preserve original404/307 assertions; use only the existing authorized Admin boundary.
